title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 高校の野球部で活躍していた私は、卒業後プロ野球の道に進んだ。最初は調子がよかったが、しばらくすると<u>スランプ</u>に陥ってしまい、将来を<u>悲観</u>してしまう時期もあった。復活を遂げた今、あの<u>挫折</u>の経験があったからこそ、ここまで成長できたのだと思う。
english_translation: I was active in my high school baseball team, and after graduation I went on to play professional baseball. At first I was in great shape, but after a while I fell into a slump, and at times I was pessimistic about the future. Now that I've achieved a comeback, I believe that setback was the experience I needed to grow so much.
